evidence.section: 4.2 Simplified evaluation of elevated temperature deformation behavior
evidence.quote: tensile tests at 350 °C of solution quenched CuNiBe (without any subsequent aging) produced uniform elongations near 50% [11], i.e., much higher than observed for CuNiBe alloys with standard precipitation hardening heat treatments
